idea-plugin.name: EAA Form Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Names every WCAG 2.2 AA form failure on its line, with the criterion and the fix

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → EAA Form Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 18 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/eaa-form-lint-wcag22 (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/eaa-form-lint-wcag22

action.text: EAA Form Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run EAA Form Lint on the file in the editor
